name: @kiwe/ai-toolkit
description: AI toolkit for creating Kiwe website, AppShell theme, and combined handoffs without reading the full plugin codebase.

scripts.test: node --check bin/kiwe.js && node --check lib/kiwe-core.js && node --check lib/binding-validator.js && node --check lib/bricks-conversion-validator.js && node --check lib/accessibility-validator.js && node --check lib/apply-planner.js && node --check lib/framework-profile-validator.js && node --check lib/bricks-theme-style-validator.js && node --check tools/validate-bricks-theme-style.cjs && node --check mcp/index.js && node -e "import('./lib/kiwe-core.js').then(m=>{const bad=m.diagnoseCommand({command:'/buid /preview /brickstheme'}); const noop=m.diagnoseCommand({command:'/create /preview /website', artifactSummary:'website/bricks-paste.html exists'}); const missingProfile=m.diagnoseCommand({command:'/convert /bricks', artifactSummary:'website/bricks-paste.html exists'}); const ok=m.diagnoseCommand({command:'/convert /bricks', artifactSummary:'website/bricks-paste.html exists; framework/kiwe-framework-profile.json exists'}); const a11y=m.diagnoseCommand({command:'/create /accessibility', artifactSummary:'website/bricks-paste.html exists'}); const missing=m.diagnoseCommand({command:'/audit /accessibility'}); if(!bad.stop || bad.code!=='unknown_command_token' || !noop.stop || noop.status!=='noop' || !missingProfile.stop || missingProfile.code!=='bricks_convert_missing_framework_profile' || ok.stop || a11y.stop || !missing.stop || missing.code!=='accessibility_audit_missing_artifact') process.exit(1);})" && node bin/kiwe.js workflow > tmp/workflow-smoke.md && node bin/kiwe.js diagnose --command "/create /preview /brickstheme" > tmp/diagnose-invalid-preview-smoke.json && node bin/kiwe.js route --command "/rebuild /seamframework" --brief "Smoke" > tmp/route-smoke.md && node bin/kiwe.js route --command "/create /frameworkprofile" --brief "Smoke" > tmp/route-framework-profile-smoke.md && node bin/kiwe.js route --command "/create /brickstheme" --brief "Smoke" > tmp/route-bricks-theme-style-smoke.md && node bin/kiwe.js route --command "/create /preview /dsatheme" --brief "Smoke" > tmp/route-theme-preview-smoke.md && node bin/kiwe.js route --command "/create /preview /combined" --brief "Smoke" > tmp/route-combined-preview-smoke.md && node bin/kiwe.js route --command "/convert /bricks" --brief "Smoke" --artifact-summary "website/bricks-paste.html exists; framework/kiwe-framework-profile.json exists" > tmp/route-bricks-smoke.md && node bin/kiwe.js route --command "/create /accessibility" --brief "Smoke" --artifact-summary "website/bricks-paste.html exists" > tmp/route-accessibility-smoke.md && node tools/validate-output.cjs --help && node tools/audit-output.cjs --help && node tools/validate-bindings.cjs --help && node tools/validate-bricks-conversion.cjs --help && node tools/validate-accessibility.cjs --help && node tools/prepare-apply-plan.cjs --help && node tools/validate-framework-profile.cjs --help && node tools/validate-bricks-theme-style.cjs --help && node tools/validate-bindings.cjs fixtures/bindings-valid --site-graph fixtures/bindings-valid/site-graph.json && node tools/validate-bricks-conversion.cjs fixtures/bricks-conversion-valid --site-graph fixtures/bricks-conversion-valid/site-graph.json && node tools/validate-accessibility.cjs fixtures/accessibility-valid && node -e "import('./lib/accessibility-validator.js').then(m=>{const r=m.validateAccessibility('fixtures/accessibility-invalid-contrast'); if(r.ok || !JSON.stringify(r).includes('accessibility_low_contrast_literal_pair')) process.exit(1);})" && node tools/prepare-apply-plan.cjs fixtures/bindings-valid --site-graph fixtures/bindings-valid/site-graph.json && node tools/validate-framework-profile.cjs fixtures/framework-profile-valid && node tools/validate-bricks-theme-style.cjs fixtures/bricks-theme-style-valid
